examples.chinese: 姊姊喜歡穿黃色的裙子。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie xǐhuān chuān huángsè de qúnzi.
examples.english: My older sister likes to wear yellow skirts.

examples.chinese: 姐姐每天晚上都讀書，她進步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, tā jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.english: My older sister studies every evening; she has improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 我姊姊是這家醫院的護理師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shì zhè jiā yīyuàn de hùlǐshī.
examples.english: My older sister is a nurse at this hospital.

examples.chinese: 今天的考試，姐姐差兩分就一百了，真可惜！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de kǎoshì, jiějie chà liǎng fēn jiù yībǎi le, zhēn kěxī!
examples.english: On today's exam, my older sister was short of two points to reach 100—what a pity!

examples.chinese: 我姐姐最近戀愛了，每個週末都跟男朋友約會。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zuìjìn liàn'ài le, měi ge zhōumò dōu gēn nánpéngyou yuēhuì.
examples.english: My older sister has recently fallen in love; every weekend she goes on dates with her boyfriend.

examples.chinese:
包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。
妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin:
Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo.
Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english:
Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best.
Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese:
我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。
那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne.
Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english:
When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought.
That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese:
張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。
姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le.
Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard.
Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 姊姊覺得木頭地板很麻煩，因為得跪著擦才擦得乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie juéde mùtou dìbǎn hěn máfan, yīnwèi děi guì zhe cā cái cā de gānjìng.
examples.english: My older sister thinks wooden floors are troublesome because you have to kneel to wipe them to get them clean.

items.wordHook: 姐(elder sister), said twice: 姐姐(elder sister).

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

items.wordHook: 太(great) + 陽(sun) → the great sun, our sun.

examples.chinese: 哥哥畢業了，下個月要去銀行工作。
examples.pinyin: Gēge bìyè le, xià ge yuè yào qù yínháng gōngzuò.
examples.english: My older brother has graduated; next month he will go to work at a bank.

examples.chinese: 我出了捷運站，就看到那家銀行了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chū le jiéyùn zhàn, jiù kàndào nà jiā yínháng le.
examples.english: As soon as I exited the MRT station, I saw that bank.

examples.chinese: 我覺得把錢存在銀行比放在家裡安全多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián cún zài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán duō le.
examples.english: I think saving money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 銀行裡有很多種表格，看你辦什麼事，就用什麼表格。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng biǎogé, kàn nǐ bàn shénme shì, jiù yòng shénme biǎogé.
examples.english: There are many kinds of forms in the bank; depending on what you're doing, you use the corresponding form.

examples.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
examples.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

examples.chinese: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
examples.pinyin: Dào yínháng kāihù, bìxū běnrén qīnzì qù bànlǐ.
examples.english: To open an account at a bank, you must go in person to handle it.

examples.chinese: 我剛來臺灣，不知道怎麼在銀行開戶存錢，請教我怎麼申請。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān, bù zhīdào zěnme zài yínháng kāihù cúnqián, qǐng jiào wǒ zěnme shēnqǐng.
examples.english: I just came to Taiwan and don't know how to open an account and deposit money at a bank; please teach me how to apply.

examples.chinese: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn de xuésheng xiǎng zài Táiwān de yínháng kāihù, děi xiān zhǔnbèi zàixué zhèngmíng.
examples.english: Students at the Mandarin Training Center who want to open an account at a bank in Taiwan must first prepare a certificate of enrollment.

examples.chinese: 你在銀行存的錢越多，得到的利息也越多。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài yínháng cún de qián yuè duō, dédào de lìxī yě yuè duō.
examples.english: The more money you deposit in the bank, the more interest you get.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

items.wordHook: 銀(silver) + 行(go): the place silver goes → a bank.

examples.chinese: 山本良介很厲害，早上剛學的五十個生字全部都記得了！
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hěn lìhài, zǎoshang gāng xué de wǔshí ge shēngzì quánbù dōu jìde le!
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke is really impressive; he remembers all fifty new characters he just learned this morning!

examples.chinese:
今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。
那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin:
Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì.
Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english:
Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium.
That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
examples.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

examples.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
examples.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

examples.chinese: 左邊的照片比右邊的好看。
examples.pinyin: Zuǒbiān de zhàopiàn bǐ yòubiān de hǎokàn.
examples.english: The photo on the left side is better looking than the one on the right side.

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: 我只參加過籃球比賽，其他運動比賽我都沒有經驗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ cānjiāguo lánqiú bǐsài, qítā yùndòng bǐsài wǒ dōu méiyǒu jīngyàn.
examples.english: I have only participated in basketball competitions; I have no experience in other sports competitions.

examples.chinese: 他跑得很快，如果跟他比賽，我沒有機會贏，一定會輸。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, rúguǒ gēn tā bǐsài, wǒ méiyǒu jīhuì yíng, yīdìng huì shū.
examples.english: He runs very fast; if I compete with him, I have no chance of winning—I will definitely lose.

examples.chinese:
華人用十二生肖代表每一年。
他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin:
Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián.
Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english:
Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year.
He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
examples.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

examples.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

examples.chinese: 你要參加學校的游泳比賽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài ma?
examples.english: Are you going to participate in the school's swimming competition?

examples.chinese: 最近天氣比較熱，我不常去運動。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bǐjiào rè, wǒ bù cháng qù yùndòng.
examples.english: Recently the weather is relatively hot, so I don't often go exercise.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

examples.chinese:
大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。
雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin:
Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo.
Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english:
In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better.
Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.
examples.english: Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster.

examples.chinese:
小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。
我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi.
Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english:
Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes.
My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese:
張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。
我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē.
Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english:
Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate.
My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jízhe mǎi, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, duō kàn jǐ jiā zài juédìng ba!
examples.english: Don't rush to buy yet; shopping around at three stores won't hurt—look at a few more stores before deciding!

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese:
那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。
林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin:
Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le.
Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english:
Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's.
Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān diànshì shàng yīlián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎoyǎn pāi de diànyǐng, yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎokàn.
examples.english: These past few days, the TV has played several movies directed by the same director in succession; each one is better than the last.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

examples.chinese:
珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。
大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin:
Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì.
Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english:
Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension.
Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 我們的足球教練認為，比賽前跑步是必要的訓練，從明天起每天得跑一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zúqiú jiàoliàn rènwéi, bǐsài qián pǎobù shì bìyào de xùnliàn, cóng míngtiān qǐ měitiān děi pǎo yī ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Our soccer coach believes that running before a game is necessary training; starting tomorrow, we have to run for an hour every day.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 何先生的肩膀比較寬，這件襯衫他穿起來太緊了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng de jiānbǎng bǐjiào kuān, zhè jiàn chènshān tā chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le.
examples.english: Mr. He's shoulders are rather wide; this shirt is too tight when he puts it on.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 小李第一次參加釣魚比賽就得了第一名，真是幸運。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ dì-yī cì cānjiā diàoyú bǐsài jiù dé le dì-yī míng, zhēn shì xìngyùn.
examples.english: Little Li got first place the first time he participated in a fishing competition; he is really lucky.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese:
一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。
「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin:
Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo.
“Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english:
Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high.
“Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese:
黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。
這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin:
Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng.
Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english:
Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise.
This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese:
你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。
下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。
昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le.
Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé.
Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends.
After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam.
Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。
examples.pinyin: Gāng jìn gōngsī de yuángōng duì huánjìng bǐjiào mòshēng, duì gōngzuò nèiróng yě bù shúxī, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào xiézhù.
examples.english: Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance.

examples.chinese: 這支手機的照相功能很強，拍出來的效果比照相機還要好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī de zhàoxiàng gōngnéng hěn qiáng, pāi chūlái de xiàoguǒ bǐ zhàoxiàngjī hái yào hǎo.
examples.english: This phone's camera function is very strong; the effect of the photos taken is even better than that of a camera.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese:
跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。
A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin:
Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén.
A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english:
Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people.
A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese:
臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。
A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin:
Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì.
A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english:
Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied.
A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

items.wordHook: a 匕(spoon) lies beside another spoon → one is sweeter 比(than) the other.

examples.chinese:
我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。
除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo.
Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english:
Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags.
On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén guò Chūnjié shí yǒu ge fēngsú, jiùshì měi hù rénjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián.
examples.english: When Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival, there is a custom: every household will paste spring couplets at the door.

examples.chinese:
東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。
我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin:
Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng.
Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english:
Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance.
My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 每次比賽到了緊張的時候，觀眾就大聲叫喊，我也跟著喊。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì bǐsài dào le jǐnzhāng de shíhòu, guānzhòng jiù dàshēng jiàohǎn, wǒ yě gēnzhe hǎn.
examples.english: Every time the game reaches a tense moment, the audience shouts loudly, and I shout along too.

examples.chinese: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái bōchū de yúlè jiémù duōbàn shì chànggē tiàowǔ de biǎoyǎn, néng ràng guānzhòng xīnqíng yúkuài.
examples.english: Most of the entertainment programs broadcast by TV stations are singing and dancing performances, which can make the audience feel happy.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
examples.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

items.wordHook: Combining 觀(observe) and 眾(multitude): 觀眾 means audience.

examples.chinese: 我們爬山爬到一半就起風了，過了幾分鐘就下起大雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen páshān pá dào yíbàn jiù qǐ fēng le, guò le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
examples.english: We were halfway up the mountain when the wind started to rise, and a few minutes later it started to rain heavily.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地區氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese:
我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。
那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā.
Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english:
I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight.
That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 何先生的肩膀比較寬，這件襯衫他穿起來太緊了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng de jiānbǎng bǐjiào kuān, zhè jiàn chènshān tā chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le.
examples.english: Mr. He's shoulders are rather wide; this shirt is too tight when he puts it on.

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 我們的足球教練認為，比賽前跑步是必要的訓練，從明天起每天得跑一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zúqiú jiàoliàn rènwéi, bǐsài qián pǎobù shì bìyào de xùnliàn, cóng míngtiān qǐ měitiān děi pǎo yī ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Our soccer coach believes that running before a game is necessary training; starting tomorrow, we have to run for an hour every day.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。
examples.pinyin: Jiùzāi gōngzuò bù róngyì, yí ge rén de lìliàng shì bú gòu de, děi dàjiā yìqǐ lái.
examples.english: Disaster relief work is not easy; one person's strength is not enough—everyone needs to come together.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.english: I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore.

examples.chinese: 華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。
examples.pinyin: Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.
examples.english: Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together.

examples.chinese: 小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán kàn qǐlái húlǐhútú de, qíshí zuò qǐ shì lái zǐxì de hěn.
examples.english: Xiaolan looks muddle-headed, but actually she is very careful when doing things.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese:
金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。
這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin:
Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le.
Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english:
When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic.
This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese:
小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。
我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi.
Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english:
Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes.
My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge rén kàn qǐlái hěn shénmì, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào tā cóng nǎlǐ lái, zuò shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: That person looks very mysterious; everyone doesn't know where he comes from or what job he does.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
examples.pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.
examples.english: For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye xiànzài měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bùdàn jīngshén hǎo le, shēntǐ yě biàn jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Grandpa now goes to bed early and gets up early every day. Not only is his spirit better, but his health has also become better.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese:
沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。
李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七零年代（1970∼1979）非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin:
Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le.
Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài (1970~1979) fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english:
I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now.
Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 晚上的風很舒服，我們一起出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnshang de fēng hěn shūfu, wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.english: The evening wind is very comfortable; let's go out for a walk together.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 我記得去年跟幾個朋友一起打過籃球，真好玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde qùnián gēn jǐ gè péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎguo lánqiú, zhēn hǎowán.
examples.english: I remember last year I played basketball with a few friends; it was really fun.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 今年你想要跟誰一起跨年？
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yìqǐ kuànián?
examples.english: Who do you want to celebrate New Year's Eve with this year?

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
examples.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

examples.chinese: A:請問你們有英文菜單嗎？ B:對不起，我們沒有。
examples.pinyin: A: Qǐngwèn nǐmen yǒu Yīngwén càidān ma? B: Duìbuqǐ, wǒmen méiyǒu.
examples.english: A: Excuse me, do you have an English menu? B: Sorry, we don't.

examples.chinese: 週末我有空，要約朋友一起去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yǒu kòng, yào yuē péngyǒu yìqǐ qù wán.
examples.english: I'm free this weekend; I want to make an appointment with friends to go out and have fun together.

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 她明天也許有空，我們可以請她一起來喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yěxǔ yǒu kòng, wǒmen kěyǐ qǐng tā yìqǐ lái hē kāfēi.
examples.english: She might be free tomorrow; we can invite her to come have coffee together.

examples.chinese: A:對不起？ B:沒關係。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ? B: Méi guānxi.
examples.english: A: Sorry? B: It's okay.

examples.chinese: 十點了，飛機快(要)起飛了。
examples.pinyin: Shí diǎn le, fēijī kuài (yào) qǐfēi le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock; the plane is about to take off.

examples.chinese: 他最近常常跟朋友一起玩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn chángcháng gēn péngyǒu yīqǐ wán.
examples.english: He often hangs out with friends recently.

examples.chinese: 你看，飛機起飛了！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, fēijī qǐfēi le!
examples.english: Look, the airplane has taken off!

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
examples.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

examples.chinese: 我們常常一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We often go to the library together.

examples.chinese: 好啊，我們一起吃蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ā, wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo.
examples.english: Great, let’s eat the cake together.

examples.chinese: 昨天我們一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We went to the library together yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 好，我們找時間一起去。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen zhǎo shíjiān yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: Okay, let’s make time for it.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 我們一起去買，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù mǎi, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: How about we go get them together?

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 從小父母就教導我要做個好人，別讓人看不起自己。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo fùmǔ jiù jiàodǎo wǒ yào zuò ge hǎorén, bié ràng rén kànbuqǐ zìjǐ.
examples.english: Since I was little, my parents taught me to be a good person and not let others look down on me.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese:
跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。
A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin:
Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén.
A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english:
Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people.
A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese:
中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。
小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu.
Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english:
The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together.
Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

items.wordHook: a 走(walk) takes the 己(self) up and out → ready to 起(rise).

examples.chinese: A:好久沒看到你父母了，請替我問候他們。 B:沒問題。
examples.pinyin: A: Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào nǐ fùmǔ le, qǐng tì wǒ wènhòu tāmen. B: Méi wèntí.
examples.english: A: I haven't seen your parents for a long time; please give them my regards. B: No problem.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，見面時晚輩先問候長輩是應有的禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, jiànmiàn shí wǎnbèi xiān wènhòu zhǎngbèi shì yīngyǒu de lǐmào.
examples.english: In Chinese society, when meeting, it is proper etiquette for the younger generation to greet the elders first.

items.wordHook: To 問(ask about) a 候(wait): 問候 means send one's respects regards to.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友的愛好一樣，都喜歡露營。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou de àihào yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan lùyíng.
examples.english: My friend and I have the same hobby—we both like camping.

examples.chinese: 她愛好化妝、穿名牌服裝，目的是希望別人讚美她。
examples.pinyin: Tā àihào huàzhuāng, chuān míngpái fúzhuāng, mùdì shì xīwàng biérén zànměi tā.
examples.english: She loves makeup and wearing name-brand clothes; her purpose is to hope others praise her.

examples.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

examples.chinese: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
examples.pinyin: Dào wàimiàn zuò le diūrén de shì, zìjǐ hé jiārén yě huì juéde diūliǎn.
examples.english: If you go out and do something shameful, you and your family will also feel disgraced.

items.wordHook: a 凵(container) holds one tall peak between two lower ridges → the rocky 山(mountain).
Combining 檢(check) and 查(investigate): 檢查 means examination.
a 言(speech) slides across a 舌(tongue) → smooth 話(talk).
Combining 重(heavy) and 新(new): 重新 means anew.
